description: Encode text into tap code (prison knock code) dots and decode tap sequences back to letters.

faqs.a: Tap code uses a 5×5 grid like Polybius: each letter is row-taps then column-taps, e.g. A is • •, C is ••• •.
The grid has no K — K is written as C, so decoding C shows C/K.
Letters are separated by / and words by // in the encoded output.

howto: Enter text or a tap-code sequence.
title: Tap Code Translator
